needs.what: the Doctor's companion deckbuilding keyword (702.xxx): a legendary creature with it may be a second commander when the other commander is a Time Lord Doctor creature
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The keyword list carries only `partner` and `choose_a_background` as two-commander permissions; partner pairs any two partners, and choose_a_background pairs with a Background enchantment, neither of which is the Doctor/companion pairing

needs.what: a goad duration "for as long as <player> controls it": the goad mark (by the original controller) ends when control of the creature changes away from the player who gained it, not at the goader's next turn and not for the rest of the game
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `goad` op's `duration` offers only the default (until the goader's next turn) and `permanent` (rest of the game, Dack Fayden), which keeps the creature goaded after control returns; `gain_control` can hand the creature over but nothing ties the goad's lifetime to that control effect
